没有留下回头应对的时间，陈启双脚用力，跳到了半空，身体连续几个空翻，每次翻到身后就是一刀跃出，打向阴影指芒。

“不光是他得罪了世界政府的罪行，还有这神奇的生命药水，也应该是属于世界政府的！”光头持剑五老星厉声喝道。

原本光滑的岩壁有着一道像是被刻意破坏了的缝隙，缝隙内部挺深，至少以陈启现在的目力看不到里面，但他看见一个熟悉的标志。

陈启站在残损焦黑的落叶中，衣裳上没有半片树叶停留，他依旧用木刀斜指着无穷高空，目光展现出一种从未出现过的桀骜。

漫天的委屈铺天盖地的朝着沈商洛砸了过来，整个身子都冰凉得彻骨，仿佛在一点点的下坠。

因为是季老居住的地方，并且是早就为沈商洛准备好的，因此这里什么东西都算是齐全。

身体原主显然也意识到了这一点，直接松开了握着钢刀的手，视线前一片泪水模糊。

金狮子即兴奋又高兴地翻看的着手中厚厚的一沓照片，这些都是记者再三天内从各个好角度拍出来的。

【说起来也是心酸，以前我家孩子挑食的很，这也不吃那也不吃，打也没用饿也没用，那时候我就想着，要是哪天孩子能不挑食，我就真的谢天谢地。

如此几秒钟之后，她就触碰到了桌子上的水果并带着水果一起消失不见。

男人这才转头看向朱天磊，经过刚才一番折腾，酒劲的确是没有了。

Without leaving any time to turn back and respond, Chen Qi used his feet to jump into the air. He flipped his body several times in a row. Every time he turned behind him, he jumped out with a knife and hit the shadow finger.

"Not only is he guilty of offending the World Government, but this magical life potion should also belong to the World Government!" The bald-headed sword-wielding Five Old Stars shouted sternly.

The originally smooth rock wall had a gap that seemed to have been deliberately destroyed. The gap was quite deep, at least with Chen Qi's current eyesight, he couldn't see inside, but he saw a familiar sign.

Chen Qi stood among the damaged and blackened leaves, with not a single leaf hanging on his clothes. He was still pointing his wooden knife diagonally at the infinite sky, his eyes showing a kind of unruliness that he had never seen before.

The overwhelming grievances hit Shen Shangluo, and his whole body was cold to the bone, as if he was falling little by little.

Because it is the place where Mr. Ji lives, and it has been prepared for Shen Shangluo a long time ago, everything here is considered complete.

The original owner of the body obviously realized this, and immediately let go of the hand holding the steel knife, his eyes blurred by tears.

The golden lion looked through the thick stack of photos with excitement and joy. These were taken by reporters from various good angles in three days.

[It’s sad to say that my child used to be very picky eaters. He wouldn’t eat this or that. There was no point in beating him or starving him. At that time, I thought, if one day my child can stop being picky eaters, I would be really thankful to God.

After a few seconds, she touched the fruit on the table and disappeared with the fruit.

The man then turned to look at Zhu Tianlei. After all the trouble just now, the alcohol was indeed gone.
